C0243.title: FTC Sues Experian for CAN-SPAM Act Violations
C0243.summary: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) filed a lawsuit against Experian Consumer Services for violating the CAN-SPAM Act by sending commercial advertising emails without user consent. Experian ultimately agreed to pay a $650,000 civil penalty and committed to complying with the CAN-SPAM Act, ceasing the sending of unauthorized advertising emails.
